headword: {東日本大震災|ひがしにほんだいしんさい}
reading: ひがしにほんだいしんさい

definitions.explanation: The disaster of March 11, 2011: a magnitude 9.0 earthquake off the Tohoku coast, the tsunami that followed, and the accident at the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant. More than 18,000 people died or went missing.

examples.japanese: {東日本大震災|ひがしにほんだいしんさい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Ten years have passed since the Great East Japan Earthquake.

examples.japanese: {東日本大震災|ひがしにほんだいしんさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the areas struck by the Great East Japan Earthquake.

examples.japanese: {東日本大震災|ひがしにほんだいしんさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After the Great East Japan Earthquake, many households began keeping emergency supplies.

notes:
The official name of the disaster. In conversation it is often simply ⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧ or 3.11 (read さんてんいちいち), and "before/after the disaster" is {震災前|しんさいまえ} / {震災後|しんさいご}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- 3.11: the date of the disaster, used as its name
- ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧: the disaster-stricken areas
- ⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧: reconstruction, recovery
- ⟦{風化|ふうか}→風化：17583_fuuka⟧⟦させない→する：00392_suru⟧: not letting (the memory) fade

RELATED WORDS:
